description: This file is a Next.js page component that displays a list of blog posts, including filtering options and links for creating new posts. It imports API methods, defines page props, manages asynchronous data fetching, and renders a complex UI with styling, dynamic content, and routing.

methods.name: BlogsPage
methods.description: An async React server component that fetches blog posts based on search parameters and renders the blog list page with filtering and UI elements.
